_doc: wifi-vap-scan bench ladder V1-V4/S1-S2 (task-110, 2026-11-25). Host-only data file; every frame is produced by src/vapscan_frames.c with the byte-exact hex in recipes/frames.md. Run only after the C1 calibration boot of STATUS 3j/3k (golden PD4 boot, ready handshake, ctx_create type 1, txq_sync72, cfg_cal 3507/0x0101 answered g1 id3 298 B). No device is contacted by this file.

schema.total_bytes: HCC frame length including the 12-byte header
schema.sr_node_word1: ((total<<16)|0x6d2b), one SR node, announce mailbox id 3
schema.expect: observables that must hold for PASS
schema.stop: hard stop conditions (any one aborts the lap, no retry)
schema.on_fail: narrow follow-up, never a retry in the same boot

phase: C1 calibration boot -> VAP/user add -> scan (V1-V4, S1-S2)
preconditions: module loaded with the PD4-patched firmware (image sha256 cfe24bfb..., research artifact)
golden boot page CA 0x1BF000 = 0x86807FEF/7/2/0xABCD, state 1, mask 0
ready handshake decoded (g4 id1 + g4 id2 payload 0x01060850), core phase >= READY_TXQ_SYNC
C1 calibration exchange already answered (g0 id2 key 0x0101 298 B -> g1 id3 298 B)
current driver h2d_send grammar must be extended with user_add / user_alg / del_user_by_mac / scan_req attributes before this ladder can run (see REPORT.md section 'Bench ladder')

expect: SR node consumed by the firmware: out[0] (CA 0x40039010) returns to 0 within the driver poll budget, h2d_status timeout=0
boot page 0x86807FEF/7/2/0xABCD and state 1 unchanged; g+0xB4/+0xB8 = 0
watch: rd_catalog delta: any new device->host frame (g1 id3 generic config-sync with syn_id 0x07xx is the plausible VAP/user confirmation)
dmesg: h2d_complete, no firmware fault lines
stop: any nonzero exception mask / exception staging frame
out[0] not consumed after the bounded poll window (h2d timeout)
boot page or core state changed
steps.on_fail: do not retry; record mask/out[]/catalog and stop - the g0 id7 handler was reached but rejected or faulted (see REPORT.md risk table)

expect: node consumed, out[0]=0, h2d ok+1, timeout=0
steps.on_fail: stop; the id8 handler copies three capability blocks into the user object (zero blocks are legal data) - a fault would mean the user object from V1 is missing, so V1 did not take effect

expect: h2d_status: ok = 5 (create+txq+cal+user_add+user_alg), timeout 0, refused 0, lane open
watch: rd_catalog snapshot as the pre-scan baseline
stop: any mismatch - do not proceed to S1
steps.on_fail: power-cycle and collect the full trace

expect: node consumed, out[0]=0, h2d ok+1, timeout=0, mask stays 0

two possible outcomes are both PASS for frame validity: (a) no device->host frame - firmware handler CA 0x6494C logs 'get vap fail' because no firmware VAP object exists yet (our M1 netdev is host-only), returns 100; (b) if a VAP 0 object exists, the scan starts and g1 id15/16/17 events appear
watch: rd_catalog: g1 id 15 (scanned BSS), id 16 (scan complete), id 17 (chan result), g2 id 2 (wal scan comp)
dmesg: handler log lines, no abort/svc
firmware exception mask and golden page
steps.on_fail: stop; record rd_catalog and mask - a scan without VAP is expected to be refused, a fault is not

expect: same as S1; the channel-entry encoding is the [I] item under test
steps.on_fail: the chan idx byte is [I] - a refusal here does not invalidate S1; record it and stop

expect: node consumed, out[0]=0, h2d ok+1, mask stays 0, page/state golden
this is the exact builder already carried by the h2d_send 'del_user' grammar
steps.on_fail: stop; user object left behind is harmless (fresh boot clears it) but record the state

global_stop_rules: NEVER write CA 0x400392F0 (out[5]) and NEVER post mailbox id 5 (firmware BUG() trap)
NEVER send an HCC frame in group 1 or group 4 (no firmware H2D receive table exists; group 4 is device->host only)
one frame per idea, one lap per boot; no retry after any failure
if the exception mask is nonzero or the boot page/state changed: stop, dump mask/out[]/catalog/dmesg, power-cycle
no device RAM writes, no firmware re-patch, no calibration writes in this ladder

expected_d2h.g1_15: hmac_scan_proc_scanned_bss: carries an 802.11 beacon/probe-response frame; the vendor host trims the trailing 20-byte descriptor before parsing IEs with mac_find_ie (SSID IE 0, DS/HT IEs). Exact prefix/trailer layout [U].
expected_d2h.g2_2: wal_scan_comp_proc_sta: WAL-level scan complete (SSID/band summary), delivered to cfg80211 scan results.
